subject.title: fix(imessage): prevent duplicate messages after delayed sends

question: Is a redacted real delayed-fallback trace required before accepting the additional 30-second iMessage send wait?
rationale: The patch is deliberately a timing boundary fix, but the available live proof only covers a five-second fast-path send and cannot establish the changed fallback behavior.

options.title: Require delayed-fallback evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted runtime trace or terminal capture shows the bridge deadline, fallback completion, and one returned send result.

options.title: Accept the dependency-contract risk
options.body: Merge based on the focused fake-timer regression and the documented upstream timing contract, accepting that the exact delayed path was not reproduced live.

recommendation.title: Require delayed-fallback evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted runtime trace or terminal capture shows the bridge deadline, fallback completion, and one returned send result.
